title: Arm CEO Rene Haas extends his contract through 2033 and will become SoftBank vice chair on December 1; a recruiting firm approached him over becoming Nvidia CEO (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Arm CEO Rene Haas extends his contract through 2033 and will become SoftBank vice chair on December 1; a recruiting firm approached him over becoming Nvidia CEO — Arm Holdings Plc Chief Executive Officer Rene Haas has pledged to stay in his current role through 2033, rebuffing approaches …
